artworks.title: Andreas Rivetus, Doctor of Divinity and Professor
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait of a man, depicted from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has aged facial features, including lines around his eyes and forehead, along with a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee. His hair is styled back, revealing a high forehead and receding hairline. He is dressed in a dark, buttoned-up garment with a broad, white pleated collar. The engraving is set within an oval frame, with an ornate band containing text below the image. The background features fine crosshatching.

artworks.title: Saint Robert, Founder and First Abbot of the Cistercian Monks
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, facing right. He has a mature face, with a high forehead and short, neatly combed hair in a tonsure style. He wears a long, flowing robe with wide sleeves, likely a monastic garment, cinched at the waist. He holds a staff in his right hand and a small object in his left. In the background are trees, water, and mountains. In the top left corner, there is a smaller image of a saint. At the bottom, there is Latin text.

artworks.title: Nicholas Roccoxius
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a chair. He has a beard, mustache, and short, neat hair. He wears a ruff, a dark garment, and a fur-lined robe. His right hand rests on papers on a table with a cloth. On the table, there is a sculpted bust and a closed book with a bookmark. Nearby is another sculpted bust of a bearded man. The background has columns, a curtain, and a view of a cityscape with a spire. It seems to be an interior with classical architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Venerable Alphonsus Rodriguez
artworks.description: The image is a drawn portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. The man is positioned facing slightly to the left, with his hands clasped together in front of him, holding a rosary. His facial features are solemn, with a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes looking upward, and a closely cut beard. The man has a bald head with a fringe of hair on the sides and back. He is wearing a high-collared, dark robe. The background is a textured pattern.

artworks.title: John Rogers, Prebendary of Saint Paul's, Protestant Martyr
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body. The man is seated and turned slightly to his left, with his right hand visible near his chest. He has a thoughtful expression. His facial features include a mustache and beard, and wavy hair reaching the nape of his neck. He wears a robe-like garment with a wide collar and layered clothing beneath. The man holds a document or book in his right hand. The background features a densely hatched pattern.

artworks.title: Rudolph II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a man in a bust-length portrait within an elaborate frame. He faces slightly to his left with a serious expression. The man has short hair and a trimmed beard and mustache, wearing richly detailed clothing, including ornate armor and a high ruff around his neck. An oval frame surrounds him with inscribed text, and cherubic figures blowing trumpets flank the oval. Above the frame, an eagle holds a globe with outstretched wings. Below, two cherubic figures sit on lions for symmetry. The background is filled with intricate patterns and classical elements.

artworks.title: Rudolph II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the right. He is sitting upright, holding a scepter in one hand and a globe in the other. The man has a beard, mustache, slightly furrowed brow, swept-back hair with a laurel wreath, and wears patterned clothing with a high collar and ruff. He has a cloak fastened by a brooch and wears an ornate chain around his neck. In the background, there is a heraldic crest to the right, with detailed etching.

artworks.title: Rudolph II in Chariot Drawn by Lion and Eagle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a kingly figure being carried by a chariot with eagles and a lion through the clouds above a cityscape. Mythological figures are depicted on clouds, and a city with spires is shown below. The drawing features a figure on a chariot, surrounded by a radiant aura. The chariot is pulled by eagles and a lion. Above, in the sky, mythological figures are shown amidst swirling clouds. Below is a detailed cityscape with various buildings and towers. Latin text is included at the top of the image. The artwork showcases intricate line work and shading techniques, creating depth and texture in the clouds and the chariot's presence.

artworks.title: Rudolph II, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, including his head, shoulders, and upper torso. He is facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a beard and mustache, neatly styled medium-length facial hair, and is wearing a tall, cylindrical hat. His hair is cropped on the sides and voluminous on top. He wears elaborate attire typical of the Renaissance period, with a large ruffed collar and a decorated garment with a chest band. The oval frame surrounding him contains intricate engravings and Latin text. The background features a textured pattern, and there are illustrated birds perched on both sides of the oval border.

artworks.title: Emperor Rudolph II
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a bearded man in an oval frame, showing his upper torso and head. The man has short, curly hair and is wearing a decorative ruff collar and ornate armor. The oval frame is surrounded by allegorical figures and symbols. A partially nude figure on the left holds a sword next to an eagle, while another figure on the right stands with a staff. The background is filled with intricate designs, architectural elements, and mythical figures. Text is present within and around the frame, including a dedicatory inscription at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Emperor Rudolph II
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in an ornate oval frame. The person is facing forward, with their head slightly turned to the side, providing a three-quarter view of their face. The individual has a full beard and mustache, wavy hair styled back adorned with a laurel wreath. The person wears detailed armor with engravings and rivets. Surrounding the central portrait, there are allegorical figures and mythical creatures. Above the portrait, a figure holding a spear is overseeing a goat-like creature. To the left and right, additional female figures are depicted holding items. At the bottom of the image, two nude male figures are seated with various objects around them. The background features decorative architectural elements. Below the portrait, there is a cartouche with a dedication and the artist's signature.

artworks.title: Emperor Rudolph II
artworks.description: This image depicts a half-length portrait of a man in engraved form. He is seated, facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a beard and mustache, with short curled hair and a crown-like headpiece. He wears elaborate armor with a circular collar resembling a ruff. His left hand rests on a baton or staff across his midsection. The background is filled with shading for depth, and there is an inscription below the image.

artworks.title: Emperor Rudolph II on Rearing Horse
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Adriaen de Vries
artworks.description: The image depicts a man on a rearing horse. He is sideways but turns his head towards the viewer, expression stern. The man has a mustache and curly hair, wearing intricate armor with a cape. He holds a spear in his right hand and the reins in his left hand. There is a sword attached to his armor. The background shows a battlefield with soldiers, cavalry, tents, and a building. An eagle soars in the sky against a cloudy backdrop.

artworks.title: Sir Benjamin Rudyerd, Politician and Poet
artworks.artist: John Payne, after Daniel Mytens the Elder
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man in 17th century attire. He has a beard and moustache, styled curly hair, and an elaborate ruffled collar. The portrait is set in an ornate oval frame with decorative elements, including intricate lines and an inscription.

artworks.title: Lady Mary Ruthven, Wife of A. Van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. She is turned slightly to her left, looking at the viewer. Her facial features are delicate with soft curves, and she has curly hair falling to her shoulders. She wears a headdress or ornament made of leaves on the left side of her head. She is dressed in a detailed garment with draped sleeves, a buttoned bodice, and a low neckline. She wears a string of pearls and drop earrings. In her right hand, she holds a rosary with a cross. The background is dark with a weave-like texture. The bottom of the image is inscribed, "Portrait de Marie Ruten femme de van Dyck."

artworks.title: Cardinal Jacopo Sadoleto
artworks.description: The image is an upper body portrait of a man titled "Iacobus Card. Sadoletus." He is slightly turned to the right, has a prominent nose, long beard with a mustache, and wears a cap that fits closely to his head. He is wearing a robe with buttons down the front. The background is plain. The text at the bottom indicates the years of creation and death as "Creat. An° 1536 Mort 1547."

artworks.title: Cardinal Jacopo Sadoleto
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man in a side profile facing left. He has a strong jawline, a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, a full beard, and a mustache. He wears a rounded cap resembling a cardinal's hat, along with a garment with a high collar and buttons. There is Latin text below the portrait identifying the person as "IACOBUS SADOLETUS, CARDINALIS."

artworks.title: Robert Cecil, First Earl of Salisbury
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. The man is positioned facing forward, with his gaze directed slightly to the viewer's right. He has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and his hair is combed back from his forehead, resting just above his ears. He wears a richly detailed collared garment with a high ruffed collar around his neck. Draped over his shoulders is a cloak. The portrait is set within an oval frame against a textured backdrop. Below the portrait is a block of text in Latin.

artworks.title: Robert Cecil, First Earl of Salisbury
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulders portrait of a man within an oval frame of an engraving. The man is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his right. He has distinct facial features such as high cheekbones, a pointed nose, and a small pointed beard with a mustache. His hair is dark and wavy, styled back from his forehead. He wears an elaborate ruffled collar and a dark outer garment with a visible embroidered pattern along the borderline. The background features intricate, horizontal line patterns.

artworks.title: Edward Montagu, First Earl of Sandwich
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the waist upwards. He is positioned slightly turned to his left but facing forward. The man has distinct facial features with a prominent nose, full lips, and heavy-lidded eyes. His hair is long, curly, and falls past his shoulders. He is wearing a traditional garment with a lace or frilled collar and armor. He has a medallion around his neck. The background features an ornate oval frame with a patterned design, set against a plain backdrop. Beneath the portrait, there is a carved or engraved description possibly detailing the man's titles and achievements.

artworks.title: Edwin Sandys, Archbishop of York
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This image is a portrait showing only the upper body of a man. He is seated and faces directly at the viewer. The man's facial features include a long, pointed beard and a high forehead, with hair that is combed back and receding at the temples. He has deep-set eyes and a stern expression. He is wearing a robe with a wide collar. The background consists of a finely detailed decorative pattern. Below the image, text identifies the person as "EDWINUS SANDUS ARCHIEPS," surrounded by more Latin text.

artworks.title: Erasmus Sarcerius
artworks.description: The image depicts an individual from the waist upwards, seated and positioned facing the viewer. The person's facial features are detailed, with a broad forehead, prominent nose, and a neutral expression. He is wearing a distinctive fur hat that covers his head, and his hair is not visible beneath it. The individual is clothed in a garment with fur-like textures, consisting of layers that suggest a robe or coat with a high collar. His hands are visible, and he is holding a book or a pamphlet, with visible text on its cover. Surrounding the figure, there is a background featuring architectural elements, like pillars, and a panel above and below him containing inscriptions. The text surrounding the image is in a font reminiscent of printing or typesetting corresponding to an earlier era. The overall color scheme is monochrome, with the details etched in a style that suggests an engraving or woodcut.

artworks.title: Laurence Saunders, Prebendary of York, Protestant Martyr
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man showing his upper body from just below the shoulders upward. He is positioned at an angle, looking to the viewer's left. The man has a full beard and mustache, along with wavy hair that appears to be receding slightly. He has a solemn expression, with deep-set eyes and a furrowed brow. He is wearing a high-collared shirt with ruffled edges under a garment that could be a robe or cloak. The background of the portrait is filled with a series of fine lines and dots. There are Latin inscriptions in serif typography below the portrait containing the name "LAURENTIVS SÆDERVS MAR" and additional text with artistic flourishes.

artworks.title: Savoy
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly at an angle to the viewer, with his body facing left and his head turned toward the viewer. The man has a mustache and a pointed beard, with high-arching eyebrows. His hair is groomed back and he is wearing a garment with intricate patterns and designs crisscrossing over his torso, along with a large ruffled collar around his neck. The background is plain with no detailed scenery or objects.
